useWhen: Read a journal export an operator already holds (MoneyForward, freee, Yayoi, QuickBooks Online or Xero), check that entries balance and accounts are classified, build a trial balance, P&L or balance sheet, or convert the journal to another of these formats
avoidWhen: Reading from or writing to a live accounting company, bank or tax authority; treating kaikei's class mapping, staged profit or retained-earnings rules as a vendor's calculation; passing a real ledger to an agent whose inference rail is remote (the tools are pure, but the agent turn is not local)

inputs.text: journal export as text, or bytes_base64 for Shift_JIS files (<= 5 MiB)

outputs.ledger: kaikei.ledger.v1 (integer minor units, one currency per ledger)
outputs.checks: balance-sheet difference, unclassified accounts, invalid entries
outputs.report: trial balance, P&L or balance sheet in kaikei, QuickBooks Report or Xero Reports shape
outputs.export: text, or bytes_base64 for Shift_JIS, plus notes on fields the format cannot hold

authority.binding: caller-authorized profile mcp_servers entry and owner-reviewed effective tool allowlist

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-22: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 0c05574, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. itonami-agent exposes the tools as mcp__kaikei__<tool> and does not start MCP subprocesses on peer runs. Data-format compatibility only; no connection to MoneyForward, freee, Yayoi, QuickBooks Online or Xero.
requires: cloud-itonami/kaikei checkout at the pinned commit

launchResolution.behavior: Resolve the absolute checkout before writing the client config. The launcher finds nbb.edn from its own path and resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text git dependency into ~/.gitlibs; no cwd is required.
